_readme: Keyed by the Sunday that starts the Official Charts week (Friday from July 2015). The pick does not have to be the No.1: any single in that week's Top 40, chosen to suit the line. pick holds the chosen entry; top holds what we know of the chart. Dry-run values came from web search because officialcharts.com and Wikipedia are blocked from the build container; scripts/fetch-charts.mjs on the Mac replaces these with the scraped top 3 and sets verified: true. instagramSearch is what to type into the Reels music picker.
